question.text: If for some,<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>,</mo></math> the lines <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>:</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></mfrac></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>:</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mi>α</mi></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>α</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mn>1</mn></mfrac></math> are coplanar, then the line <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> passes through the point :

solution.text:
Lines are coplanar
so α5-α12-11+1+32=0
⇒-5α+(α-5)3+7=0
⇒-2α=8⇒α=-4
⇒L2:x+2-4=y+19=z+11
Now by cross checking option (1) is correct.
